newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: CRICKET-JAYASURIYA AND MAHANAMA BREAK ALL-TIME RECORD.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-JAYASURIYA AND MAHANAMA BREAK ALL-TIME RECORD.

text.p: Sri Lankan second wicket pair Sanath Jayasuriya and Roshan Mahanama set a world record for any wicket in test cricket of 468 against India on Tuesday.
They beat the previous best 467 scored by New Zealanders Andrew Jones and Martin Crowe against Sri Lanka in Wellington in 1991.
The record fell when Mahanama, 188 not out, cut off-spinner Rajesh Chauhan to the boundary.
The pair, who had earlier wiped out Don Bradman and Bill Ponsford's second wicket record of 451 for Australia against England in 1934, had batted for 677 minutes and faced 974 balls.

Jayasuriya was unbeaten on 275 and had already become the highest individual scorer for Sri Lanka when he passed the 267 which Aravinda de Silva made in the same test that Jones and Crowe set their record.
